// src/mockData.js
export const INITIAL_MENU = [
  { id: 'p1', name: 'Capricciosa', price: 150, category: 'Pizza', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Capricciosa', averagePreparationTime: 12, description: 'Classic pizza.', stock: 20 },
  { id: 'p2', name: 'Sicilian', price: 200, category: 'Pizza', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Sicilian', averagePreparationTime: 14, description: 'Spicy pizza.', stock: 15 },
  { id: 'p3', name: 'Marinara', price: 90, category: 'Pizza', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Marinara', averagePreparationTime: 10, description: 'Simple and tasty.', stock: 25 },
  { id: 'p4', name: 'Pepperoni', price: 300, category: 'Pizza', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Pepperoni', averagePreparationTime: 13, description: 'A fan favorite.', stock: 18 },
  { id: 'b1', name: 'Double Cheeseburger', price: 250, category: 'Burger', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Burger', averagePreparationTime: 8, description: 'Two patties.', stock: 30 },
  { id: 'd1', name: 'Coca-Cola L', price: 50, category: 'Drink', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Drink', averagePreparationTime: 1, description: 'Large size.', stock: 50 },
  { id: 'f1', name: 'French Fries', price: 110, category: 'French fries', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Fries', averagePreparationTime: 5, description: 'Crispy salted fries.', stock: 40 },
  { id: 'v1', name: 'Garden Salad', price: 140, category: 'Veggies', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=Veggies', averagePreparationTime: 6, description: 'Fresh vegetables.', stock: 15 },
];

export const INITIAL_TABLES = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `t${i + 1}`,
  number: i + 1,
  size: (i % 4) * 2 + 2, // Assigns sizes 2, 4, 6, 8
  status: (i % 5 === 0 || i < 4) ? 'Reserved' : 'Available',
  name: null,
}));

export const INITIAL_ORDERS = [
  {
    id: 108,
    items: [
      { id: 'd1', name: 'Coca-Cola L', quantity: 1, price: 50 },
      { id: 'm1', name: 'Apple Pie', quantity: 1, price: 100 }, 
      { id: 'b1', name: 'Double Cheeseburger', quantity: 1, note: 'Add extra pickles', price: 250 },
      { id: 'm2', name: 'Value Set Meals', quantity: 1, price: 0 }
    ],
    status: 'processing',
    time: '9:37 AM',
    table: 'Table-05',
    type: 'Dine In',
    itemCount: 4,
    duration: '4 Min',
    phone: '9109109109',
    name: 'Divya Sigatapu'
  },
  {
    id: 109,
    items: [{ id: 'p4', name: 'Pepperoni', quantity: 2, price: 300 }],
    status: 'done',
    time: '9:40 AM',
    table: 'Takeaway',
    type: 'Take Away',
    itemCount: 2,
    duration: '0 Min',
    phone: '9876543210',
    name: 'Test User'
  }
];
